text: DSH Claude Theme 是面向 DSH Web 界面的 Claude 风格主题插件。它通过客户端主题扩展覆盖浅色与深色配色，并注入字体样式和字号缩放规则。主题提供暖纸色背景、赤陶强调色、会话衬线字体、代码等宽字体，以及随正文设置缩放的界面字号。适合希望调整 DSH Web 阅读与操作观感的用户；Anthropic 字体可选安装，未安装时回退到系统字体。

DSH Claude Theme gives the DSH web interface a Claude-inspired look. The client applies light and dark palette tokens, typography styles, and proportional UI font scaling. It uses warm surfaces, terracotta accents, serif conversation text, and monospace code. Anthropic fonts are optional.
想把 DSH 网页换成暖纸色和赤陶色的 Claude 风格。
DSH 的正文和代码能分别使用衬线字体与等宽字体吗？
Make the DSH web interface use a warm Claude-inspired palette and typography.
DSH Claude Theme 的功能「Claude 风格网页主题」：为 DSH Web 界面应用浅色和深色配色 token，并注入正文、标题与代码字体规则；同时将符合范围的固定字号和行高按正文设置缩放。主题通过客户端模块自动应用。

@RunhuaChen/dsh-claude-theme README · dsh-claude-theme：给 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）Web 界面用的 Claude 风格主题：暖纸质底色、赤陶强调色、Anthropic 字体，外加让整个界面跟着字号设置一起缩放。

配色由作者在 OpenAI Codex 的 `absolutely` 主题基础上自行调校而来：保留它纸白 `#fcfcfb`、近黑 `#181817`、赤陶 `#da7756` 的基调，重新推导了整套中性色阶和强调色阶，并补齐到 DSH 需要的 82 个颜色变量。深浅两套都做了，跟随 DSH 的「浅色 / 深色 / 跟随系统」设置。

@RunhuaChen/dsh-claude-theme README · 效果：| 项目 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| 底色 | 纸白 `#fcfcfb`，侧栏和代码块略沉一点 |
| 文字 | 近黑 `#181817`，次要文字是暖灰阶 |
| 强调色 | 赤陶橙 `#da7756`，用在链接、焦点环、选中态、信息按钮 |
| 差异色 | 新增 `#22863a`、删除 `#cf3e2e`（文件 diff 的标记、底色、行号槽） |
| 完成态 | `#8f5f3a`，替换原本的紫色 |
| 弹层 | 菜单改成不透明暖白，不再透出底下的内容 |
| 正文 | 会话内容用 Anthropic Serif 衬线体 |
| 代码 | Anthropic Mono 等宽体 |
| 界面字号 | 侧栏、顶栏、按钮、菜单的字号跟随「设置 → 外观 → 字体大小」一起缩放 |

@RunhuaChen/dsh-claude-theme README · 字体：插件不打包字体文件。Anthropic 的字体归 Anthropic 所有，只允许个人使用，不能随插件再分发。没装字体时界面会回退到系统字体，主题颜色和排版规则照常生效。

想要和截图完全一致的效果，自己安装这三款字体（Text 光学尺寸的 Regular 和 Bold 就够）：

```
AnthropicSans-Regular.ttf    AnthropicSans-Bold.ttf
AnthropicSerif-Regular.ttf   AnthropicSerif-Bold.ttf
AnthropicMono-Regular.ttf
```

GitHub 上有几个第三方仓库提供这些字体的 TTF 和 woff2 导出，例如 [matthieuhuguet/anthropic-fonts](https://github.com/matthieuhuguet/anthropic-fonts)（`ttf/` 目录）。也可以从 Claude 的桌面应用里提取。安装后重新加载页面即可，不需要重启 DSH。

中文字体不需要额外安装，会回退到系统里的雅黑或苹方。

@RunhuaChen/dsh-claude-theme README · 安装：前提：DSH 运行时版本 `>=0.2.0-rc.1 <0.3.0-0`，并且在 Web 界面里使用。

克隆仓库，然后把仓库根目录交给 DSH 的插件安装器：

```bash
git clone https://github.com/RunhuaChen/dsh-claude-theme.git
```

在 DSH 的会话里让 Agent 安装这个本地包目录：

> 用 plugin_manager 把我的 dsh-claude-theme 仓库目录装成 bundle，目录是 /你的路径/dsh-claude-theme

或者直接调用插件管理工具：

```json
{ "action": "install_bundle", "target": "/你的路径/dsh-claude-theme" }
```

安装完成后刷新页面。如果刷新后没有任何变化，把 DSH 应用完整重启一次，让客户端模块清单重新收集。

@RunhuaChen/dsh-claude-theme README · 工作原理：- `index.js` 是宿主侧入口，留空。
- `cordis.patch.yml` 往组合里插一行 `dsh-claude-theme`。
- `client.js` 在 Web 界面里做三件事：
  1. 调用 `ctx.theme.overrideTokens()` 注册 82 个 `--dsw-*` 颜色 token，每个 token 给出浅色和深色两个值。这是 DSH 官方的主题扩展点，优先于内置样式表，也自动跟随明暗切换。
  2. 注入一段样式表，把 `--dsh-font-family-text`、`--dsh-font-family-code`、`--dsh-font-family-terminal` 指向 Anthropic 字体，并给会话正文和标题套上衬线字体（`pre`、`code` 仍用等宽体）。
  3. 读出页面上所有已生效的样式表，把 9–20px 的固定字号改写成以正文字号为基准的等比缩放，这样侧栏、顶栏、按钮、菜单这些写死像素的界面元素也会跟着字号设置变化。上限是原来的 1.35 倍，避免撑破布局。
@RunhuaChen/dsh-claude-theme README · 工作原理：颜色不走样式表覆盖，是因为 DSH 的 token 展示层把颜色写成 body 的内联自定义属性，只有 `overrideTokens` 这种方式才能稳定压过内置值。

@RunhuaChen/dsh-claude-theme README · 已知限制：- 只适配 Web 界面，桌面端的原生窗口框架不在范围内。
- 界面字号缩放只改字号和行高，不改按钮写死的高度和内边距。个别按钮在极大字号下可能显得紧凑。
- 界面缩放依赖运行时读取样式表，DSH 大版本改动样式结构后可能需要更新插件。
- 代码块里语法高亮的具体颜色由 DSH 的 shiki 主题决定，插件只改代码块的底色和边框，改不了高亮色本身。

@RunhuaChen/dsh-claude-theme README · 开发：`client.js` 由仓库的生成脚本生成，色板在脚本里用 OKLCH 推导（中性色相 85°，强调色相 39°），改颜色请改脚本后重新生成，不要手改 `client.js`。

```bash
node gen-theme-client.mjs      # 重新生成 client.js
node check-theme-client.mjs    # 桩测：模块注册、token 形状、样式注入
node check-chrome-scale.mjs    # 桩测：界面字号改写规则
```
@RunhuaChen/dsh-claude-theme README · 许可：代码以 MIT 许可发布，见 `LICENSE`。配色方案由本项目作者调校，按同一许可开放，转载或二次分发时请保留出处。Anthropic 字体不在此许可范围内，插件也不包含任何字体文件。
@RunhuaChen/dsh-claude-theme README · 致谢：配色由本项目的作者在 OpenAI Codex 的 `absolutely` 主题基础上自行优化，并适配为 DSH 的颜色体系。字体属于 Anthropic，界面结构属于 DeepSeek Harness。

@RunhuaChen/dsh-claude-theme README · dsh-claude-theme：A Claude-flavoured theme for the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai) (DSH) web UI: warm paper surfaces, terracotta accent, Anthropic typefaces, and UI chrome that scales with the font-size setting.

@RunhuaChen/dsh-claude-theme README · dsh-claude-theme：The palette is hand-tuned by the author on top of the OpenAI Codex `absolutely` theme: it keeps that theme's paper white `#fcfcfb`, near-black `#181817` and terracotta `#da7756`, but re-derives the whole neutral and accent ramps and maps them onto the 82 colour variables DSH needs. Both light and dark variants are included and follow DSH's own appearance setting.

@RunhuaChen/dsh-claude-theme README · What it changes：| Area | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Surfaces | Paper white `#fcfcfb`; sidebar and code blocks sit slightly lower |
| Text | Near-black `#181817`, warm grey secondary levels |
| Accent | Terracotta `#da7756` for links, focus rings, selection and info buttons |
| Diffs | Added `#22863a`, removed `#cf3e2e` markers, backgrounds and gutters |
| Done state | `#8f5f3a` instead of the built-in violet |
| Menus | Opaque warm white instead of translucent panels |
| Conversation | Anthropic Serif for prose |
| Code | Anthropic Mono |
| UI chrome | Sidebar, top bar, buttons and menus scale with Settings → Appearance → font size |

@RunhuaChen/dsh-claude-theme README · Fonts：The plugin ships no font files. The Anthropic typefaces are proprietary, licensed for personal use only, and must not be redistributed with the plugin. Without them the UI falls back to system fonts; colours and layout rules still apply.

For the exact look, install these five static instances (Text optical size, Regular and Bold are enough):

```
AnthropicSans-Regular.ttf    AnthropicSans-Bold.ttf
AnthropicSerif-Regular.ttf   AnthropicSerif-Bold.ttf
AnthropicMono-Regular.ttf
```

@RunhuaChen/dsh-claude-theme README · Fonts：Third-party GitHub repos publish TTF and woff2 exports, for example [matthieuhuguet/anthropic-fonts](https://github.com/matthieuhuguet/anthropic-fonts) (see its `ttf/` directory). You can also extract them from the Claude desktop app. Reload the page after installing; no DSH restart is needed.

No extra CJK font is required: Chinese text falls back to the system face.

@RunhuaChen/dsh-claude-theme README · Install：Requires a DSH runtime `>=0.2.0-rc.1 <0.3.0-0` and the web surface.

```bash
git clone https://github.com/RunhuaChen/dsh-claude-theme.git
```

Hand the repository directory to the DSH plugin installer:

```json
{ "action": "install_bundle", "target": "/path/to/dsh-claude-theme" }
```

Or simply ask the agent in a DSH session to install that directory as a bundle. Reload the page afterwards. If nothing changes after a reload, restart the DSH app once so the client module list is collected again.
@RunhuaChen/dsh-claude-theme README · Install：Uninstall with `{ "action": "remove_bundle", "target": "@RunhuaChen/dsh-claude-theme" }`.

@RunhuaChen/dsh-claude-theme README · How it works：- `index.js` is the host entry and stays empty.
- `cordis.patch.yml` inserts a `dsh-claude-theme` entry into the composition.
- `client.js` runs in the browser and does three things:
  1. Registers 82 `--dsw-*` colour tokens through `ctx.theme.overrideTokens()`, each with a light and a dark value. This is the official theme extension point: it wins over the built-in stylesheet and follows appearance switches automatically.
  2. Injects a stylesheet pointing `--dsh-font-family-text`, `--dsh-font-family-code` and `--dsh-font-family-terminal` at the Anthropic faces, and applies the serif face to conversation prose and headings (`pre`/`code` stay monospace).
  3. Reads every live stylesheet, rewrites fixed font sizes between 9 and 20px into proportional `calc()` values relative to the body font size, so pixel-sized chrome scales with the setting. Growth is capped at 1.35× to avoid breaking layouts.

@RunhuaChen/dsh-claude-theme README · How it works：Colour overrides go through the theme API rather than a stylesheet because DSH's token presenter writes colours as inline custom properties on `body`; only registered overrides reliably win there.

@RunhuaChen/dsh-claude-theme README · Known limits：- Web surface only; the desktop window frame is out of scope.
- Chrome scaling adjusts font size and line height only, not fixed control heights or padding, so a few controls can look tight at very large sizes.
- Chrome scaling depends on runtime stylesheet scanning; a major DSH restyle may require an update.
- Syntax highlighting inside code blocks comes from DSH's shiki theme. The plugin only changes the block background and border.

@RunhuaChen/dsh-claude-theme README · Development：`client.js` is generated by the repository's generator script, which derives the palette in OKLCH (neutral hue 85°, accent hue 39°). Edit the generator and regenerate; do not hand-edit `client.js`.

```bash
node gen-theme-client.mjs      # regenerate client.js
node check-theme-client.mjs    # stub test: registration, token shape, style injection
node check-chrome-scale.mjs    # stub test: chrome scaling rules
```

@RunhuaChen/dsh-claude-theme README · License：MIT for the code, see `LICENSE`. The palette is tuned by this project's author and released under the same licence; keep the attribution when you redistribute it. The Anthropic fonts are not covered by that licence and no font files are included.

@RunhuaChen/dsh-claude-theme README · Credits：Palette optimised by this project's author on top of the OpenAI Codex `absolutely` theme and mapped onto DSH's colour system. Fonts belong to Anthropic; the interface belongs to DeepSeek Harness.
